blopa_4_you: Jakub You arrived at R-F10 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Jakub You is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Jakub You turned a year older today. The bay sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle.

A rat stole Jakub You's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier. Verdel Ridge is lost. Jakub You heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
ya_man_caleb: Walter Caleb arrived with the Day 3 draft, carrying a pressed cornflower and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
